meta.name: Ghosts: Halloween Episodes
meta.description: 7 Halloween episodes of Ghosts. The annual Halloween episodes.

videos.title: Halloween
videos.name: Halloween
videos.overview: On Halloween at Woodstone Mansion, the ghosts try to help Sam and Jay protect their home from the neighborhood kids who annually vandalize the house.

videos.title: Halloween 2: The Ghost of Hetty's Past
videos.name: Halloween 2: The Ghost of Hetty's Past
videos.overview: A seance at Sam and Jay's last-minute Halloween party conjures up a spirit from Hetty's past. Also, Isaac worries Nigel will be turned off by his ghost power.

videos.title: Halloween 3: The Guest Who Wouldn't Leave
videos.name: Halloween 3: The Guest Who Wouldn't Leave
videos.overview: Pete's ex-wife, Carol, shows up at Woodstone Mansion during Sam and Jay's Halloween party, where they're trying to impress some cool friends. Also, the ghosts hope to bring Flower back with a seance.

videos.title: Halloween 4: The Witch
videos.name: Halloween 4: The Witch
videos.overview: The Ghosts seeking some excitement during a low key Halloween join Patience in putting Sam on a witch trial.

videos.title: Halloween 5: The Mummy
videos.name: Halloween 5: The Mummy
videos.overview: Sam and Jays Halloween takes a spooky turn when they accidentally unleash a mummy ghost.

videos.title: Halloween 6: The Mirror (1)
videos.name: Halloween 6: The Mirror (1)
videos.overview: A couple of months after Petes disappearance, while Sam is in Australia on the set of her new film, Polar Opposites, Kyle steps up to help baby-sit the ghosts. Also, Hetty is unexpectedly reunited with her estranged sister, Margaret.

videos.title: Halloween 6: The Mirror (2)
videos.name: Halloween 6: The Mirror (2)
videos.overview: Bela throws an unconventional Halloween bash at Woodstone as tensions boil over between Hetty and Margaret.
